items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I heard Artie Shaw play the Clarinet Concerto on the radio... And I fantasized.

ctx.x: What put a clarinet in your hands as a young kid?

The fact, one I couldn’t figure out how to play a trumpet, and we couldn’t afford a piano. That was my first love was the piano. Second I wanted to learn the trumpet. I didn’t know how you could get all those notes out of just three valves, there was something wrong with that picture. I mean math was not my strong point. Then I heard Artie Shaw play the Clarinet Concerto on the radio. I guess this had to be about 1945 or 6. And I fantasized. This instrument was sailing over the whole band and I liked that whole…
